name: Dual Kernel Subspace Disguise
description: Transforms the primal linear span condition into a dual condition on the intersection of kernels. By defining the objective as ensuring the joint kernel of selected functionals is a subspace of the target functionals' kernels, the problem is rigorously identical to finding a connected component in a graph (Minimum Steiner Tree) but uses vocabulary from functional analysis and linear algebra. This prevents models from easily mapping the problem to graph theory or recognizing the Steiner tree structure without deep algebraic reasoning, while simultaneously removing the explicit hint about non-target intermediate dimensions observed in the traces.
